guides.definition: pushState adds a session-history entry containing optional state and a same-origin URL. Applications should also handle popstate when users navigate backward or forward.

parameters.name: stateKey
parameters.description: A property stored in the history entry state object.

parameters.name: stateValue
parameters.description: A structured-cloneable value stored for the entry.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A same-origin URL represented by the new entry.

examples.title: Navigate to a settings view
examples.explanation: The displayed URL and history stack change without a document load, and popstate observes later traversal.
